notes: Four distinct localized object-part episodes are visible: one left-side drawer, two separately manipulated hinged upper-cabinet doors, and one right-side utensil drawer. The two upper-door closing transitions occur within the short interval between frames 544 and 560, so their individual ordering and midpoints are less certain.
scene_description: A user surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer left of the stove, separately opens and closes the two doors of an upper cabinet above the cooktop, and finally opens and closes a utensil drawer right of the stove.
